## Claim policy
We do **not** claim pixel-perfect parity with the original Claude Design V5 without side-by-side comparison against the reference source. Screenshots are evidence of layout, clipping, and functional fidelity. Manual owner comparison against `reference/v5` remains required.

- 1897×860 (story price panel historically clipped)
- 390×844 (mobile story)
- Additional: 1440×900, 768×1024
